assumptions: Upright strips from one page; missing strips are not identified.

matching.method: full-height edge ink and text-row traces; affine refinement and constrained local alignment

ocr.reason: Install Tesseract and its requested language data to enable OCR.

verification.pair_score_fallback: Use the visual score alone when fewer than three text lines touch the join.

refinement.stop_reason: OCR disabled or fewer than three text strips.

document_contents: Text-bearing strips only. Low-ink strips stay in normalized_strips with unresolved positions.

preview.alignment: affine plus smooth local row offsets
